title: Rotating disc with a central hole, plane stress
source: Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill 1970, §32 (rotating disc of uniform thickness with a hole)

quantities.quantity: hoop stress σ_θ = σ_yy at the bore (20, 0)
quantities.reason: stress extrapolated to the bore surface, where the a²b²/r² term is steepest: 16 radial quadratic elements graded towards the bore leave about 0.2% (8 uniform: −2.4%; 32 graded: −0.05%)

quantities.quantity: radial stress σ_r = σ_xx at r = √(ab), its maximum
quantities.reason: the nearest node to √(ab) is within half an element of it, where σ_r is stationary (an error of order (h/r)², under 0.5%), and nodal averaging adds a few tenths of a percent

quantities.quantity: hoop stress σ_θ = σ_yy at the rim (100, 0)
